-- Full test query to see controller stress with model series
SELECT 
    sc.systemoverseeractuation AS actuator_id,
    sc.overseerloadvalue,
    sc.memuseval,
    (sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval) / 2.0 AS controller_stress,
    rd.modelseriesval
FROM system_controller sc
JOIN operation op ON sc.systemoverseeroperation = op.operreg
JOIN robot_record rr ON op.operrecref = rr.botcode
JOIN robot_details rd ON rr.botcode = rd.botdetreg
LIMIT 5;

-- Build the full query with CTE for model averages
WITH controller_stress AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.systemoverseeractuation AS actuator_id,
        sc.overseerloadvalue,
        sc.memuseval,
        (sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval) / 2.0 AS controller_stress,
        rd.modelseriesval,
        rr.botcode AS robot_code
    FROM system_controller sc
    JOIN operation op ON sc.systemoverseeroperation = op.operreg
    JOIN robot_record rr ON op.operrecref = rr.botcode
    JOIN robot_details rd ON rr.botcode = rd.botdetreg
),
model_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        modelseriesval,
        AVG(controller_stress) AS avg_stress
    FROM controller_stress
    GROUP BY modelseriesval
)
SELECT 
    cs.actuator_id,
    cs.robot_code,
    cs.controller_stress,
    ma.avg_stress,
    cs.modelseriesval
FROM controller_stress cs
JOIN model_avg ma ON cs.modelseriesval = ma.modelseriesval
WHERE cs.controller_stress > 1.20 * ma.avg_stress
LIMIT 10;

    SELECT 
        sc.systemoverseeractuation AS actuator_id,

        rd.mfgnameval,

        rd.payloadcapkg

    JOIN robot_record rr ON op.operrecref = rr.botcode
    JOIN robot_details rd ON rr.botcode = rd.botdetreg
),
model_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        modelseriesval,
        AVG(controller_stress) AS avg_stress
    FROM controller_stress
    GROUP BY modelseriesval
)
SELECT
